buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Additional Terms & Conditions for Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) The following additional Terms & Conditions may be incorporated into the AMC agreement for maintenance of Computers, Printers, and related IT equipment: 1. Comprehensive AMC Coverage · The AMC shall be on a Comprehensive Basis, covering all labou r charges and replacement/repair of defective spare parts, accessories (H DMI cable, VGA Cable & printer USB cable) and components required for maintaining the equipment in proper working condition, excluding cons umable items of computers (Desktops & Laptops) and printers. · The service provider shall repair or replace defective components with new or equivalent standard components of the same or higher specifi cations at no additional cost to the department. · All replacement parts shall be genuine, compatible with the equip ment, and conform to the original manufacturer's specifications. · The service provider shall maintain adequate stock of commonly r equired spare parts to ensure prompt rectification of faults and minimum downtime. · In case any equipment cannot be repaired within 48 hours of repo rting the complaint, a standby unit of equivalent or higher configuration s hall be provided until the original equipment is repaired and reinstalled.

Exclusions: The following consumable items of computers (Desktops & Laptops) and printers shall not be covered under the Comprehensive AMC and shall b e supplied by the department separately: · Printer cartridges and toner cartridges · Ink bottles/ink tanks · Drum units and imaging units · Printer heads · Any other consumable items having a limited life due to normal u sage "The AMC shall be comprehensive in nature, including repair and repla cement of defective spare parts/components of covered equipment. H owever, consumable items related to computers and printers shall rem ain outside the scope of the AMC and shall be provided by the departm ent separately." 2. Deployment of Resident Engineer · The service provider shall depute one qualified and experienced e ngineer at the office premises on all working days during normal office wo rking hours throughout the AMC period. · The resident engineer shall attend to all complaints, preventive m aintenance activities, and other IT-related support services as assigned by the office. · The resident engineer shall liaise with the OEM and raise ticket for repair of all the items not under AMC but under warranty. · In case of absence of the deployed engineer due to leave or any other reason, the service provider shall arrange a suitable substitute without affecting the services. · The resident engineer shall attend the meeting in the office when ever called for and liable to respond on the matter relating to IT. 3. Preventive Maintenance (PM) · Preventive maintenance of all covered equipment shall be carried out on a quarterly basis (once every three months). · Preventive maintenance shall include, but not be limited to: · Internal and external cleaning of Desktop PCs, monitors, keyboards, mice and printers. · Removal of dust from components using appropriate cleani ng methods and tools. · Checking and tightening of cable connections and periphera l interfaces. · Verification of proper functioning of hardware components.

4. Printer Maintenance · Quarterly preventive maintenance of printer. · Preventive maintenance shall include: · Cleaning of printer mechanisms and internal components. · Lubrication of printer gears and moving mechanical parts us ing manufacturer-recommended lubricants, wherever applicable. · Inspection and adjustment of rollers, trays, and paper feedi ng mechanisms. · Ensuring optimal print quality and performance. 5. Shifting and Reinstallation of Equipment · The service provider shall undertake shifting/reinstallation of com puters, printers, and peripheral devices from one location to another withi n the office premises whenever required by the department. · The scope shall include disconnection, transportation within the p remises, reinstallation, reconnection, and testing of equipment to ensure proper functionality. 6. Software Installation and Support · Installation, configuration, troubleshooting, and repair of operatin g systems and application software provided/licensed by the department shall be included under the AMC. · The service provider shall assist in: § Installation and configuration of authorized software. § Troubleshooting software-related issues. § Reinstallation of software in case of system failure or corruption. § Installation and configuration of printers, drivers, and other perip herals. 7. Operating System Updates · The service provider shall ensure timely Operating System (OS) u pdates, security patches, and driver updates for all covered systems as p er departmental policy and compatibility requirements. · Necessary precautions, including data backup (where instructed b y the department), shall be taken before major updates. 8. Complaint Response and Resolution · All complaints reported during working hours shall be attended to immediately by the resident engineer. · Critical faults affecting office functioning shall be resolved on prio rity. · If a fault cannot be rectified onsite, suitable standby equipment

shall be provided, wherever feasible, until the original equipment is repair ed. 9. Maintenance Records · The service provider shall maintain a Preventive Maintenance Register/Log Book containing details of PM activities carried out, compl aints attended, repairs undertaken, and parts replaced. · The register shall be countersigned by the designated departmen tal officer after each PM cycle. 10. Reporting · A quarterly report indicating preventive maintenance activities co mpleted, pending issues, equipment status, and recommendations shall b e submitted to the designated officer of the department. 11. No Additional Cost · All services mentioned above shall be provided without any add itional financial implication to the department and shall be deemed in cluded within the AMC charges, unless specifically excluded in the contra ct. 12. Penalty · Ordinarily a complaint must be attended to and resolved immedia tely when no change of spare part is involved, however in the case of req uirement of change of spare parts, the complaint should be resolved withi n 48 hours of its receipt. Majority of faults should be rectified in the first r esponse itself. However, maximum period is allowed for defect rectificatio n is 48 hours. In case the complaint is neither resolved nor a standby equi pment is provided within 48 hours, a penalty of Rs. 200/- per day or part t hereof will be imposed. · In case of absence of resident engineer, a penalty of Rs. 500/- per day or part thereof will be levied. 13. Comprehensive AMC Coverage · The AMC shall be on a Comprehensive Basis, covering all labou r charges and replacement/repair of defective spare parts, accessories (H DMI cable, VGA Cable & printer USB cable) and components required for maintaining the equipment in proper working condition, excluding cons umable items of computers (Desktops & Laptops) and printers. · The service provider shall repair or replace defective components with new or equivalent standard components of the same or higher specifi cations at no additional cost to the department. · All replacement parts shall be genuine, compatible with the equip ment, and conform to the original manufacturer's specifications. · The service provider shall maintain adequate stock of commonly r equired spare parts to ensure prompt rectification of faults and minimum downtime. · In case any equipment cannot be repaired within 48 hours of repo rting the complaint, a standby unit of equivalent or higher configuration s hall be provided until the original equipment is repaired and reinstalled.

Exclusions: The following consumable items of computers (Desktops & Laptops) and printers shall not be covered under the Comprehensive AMC and shall b e supplied by the department separately: · Printer cartridges and toner cartridges · Ink bottles/ink tanks · Drum units and imaging units · Printer heads · Any other consumable items having a limited life due to normal u sage "The AMC shall be comprehensive in nature, including repair and repla cement of defective spare parts/components of covered equipment. H owever, consumable items related to computers and printers shall rem ain outside the scope of the AMC and shall be provided by the departm ent separately." 2. Deployment of Resident Engineer · The service provider shall depute one qualified and experienced e ngineer at the office premises on all working days during normal office wo rking hours throughout the AMC period. · The resident engineer shall attend to all complaints, preventive m aintenance activities, and other IT-related support services as assigned by the office. · The resident engineer shall liaise with the OEM and raise ticket for repair of all the items not under AMC but under warranty. · In case of absence of the deployed engineer due to leave or any other reason, the service provider shall arrange a suitable substitute without affecting the services. · The resident engineer shall attend the meeting in the office when ever called for and liable to respond on the matter relating to IT. 3. Preventive Maintenance (PM) · Preventive maintenance of all covered equipment shall be carried out on a quarterly basis (once every three months). · Preventive maintenance shall include, but not be limited to: · Internal and external cleaning of Desktop PCs, monitors, keyboards, mice and printers. · Removal of dust from components using appropriate cleani ng methods and tools. · Checking and tightening of cable connections and periphera l interfaces. · Verification of proper functioning of hardware components.

Shifting and Reinstallation of Equipment · The service provider shall undertake shifting/reinstallation of com puters, printers, and peripheral devices from one location to another withi n the office premises whenever required by the department. · The scope shall include disconnection, transportation within the p remises, reinstallation, reconnection, and testing of equipment to ensure proper functionality. 6.
